dossier.headline: Heavyweights and defensives cap Thursday's gains
dossier.summary: Through November 12, a shifting group of sectors and heavyweights held the market back: pharma, IT and autos in the morning, then IT, FMCG and autos at midday. By early afternoon M&M, TCS and Nestle India were named among the top losers, and no company-specific trigger had been reported for any of them.
why_it_matters: Losses in index heavyweights trimmed most of the late-morning gain
Sustained FII buying and lower crude were cited as support for the wider market
